AUTHOR: Canovi
TITLE: Trajectory-based fish event classification through pre-training with diffusion models
REGION: Austevoll, western Norway (20 corkwing wrasse nests, June-July 2022)
SPECIES: Corkwing wrasse Symphodus melops (nesting males); 12 behavioural event classes
DATA: Own nest-camera videos; 16,937 fixed-length trajectories from Tracktor (Faster R-CNN) tracking, annotated in BORIS
D2: Stratified 80/20 train/validation at original-trajectory level (13,489 / 3,448 fixed-length samples)
D_EV: Sec. 5: stratified split 'applied ... to the original trajectories of variable length ... to ensure that each trajectory belongs exclusively to either the train or validation splits'
R_EV: Sec. 7.1: 'One notable limitation is the use of a single dataset in both the proposed method and other methods employed in this study.'
C_EV: no statement found (argmax over 12 MLP outputs; no score threshold, reject or unsure rule)
E_EV: Sec. 5/Table 3: 'We report the F1-score and G-mean results for Macro ... and Weighted averages'; only classification metrics
ARCH: Tracktor (Faster R-CNN) tracking -> trajectories; unsupervised k-diffusion MLP encoder-decoder pre-training + MLP classifier; baselines: hand-crafted features+SVM, 1D-CNN, autoencoder+MLP; SMOTE/focal loss
METR: Macro/weighted F1, macro/weighted G-mean, per-class accuracy, confusion matrices
NOTE: Split is random at the trajectory (event) level across 20 nests/videos, not by video or nest; trajectory-level grouping of fixed-length segments counted as explicit leakage control (D4=Y). Also, unsupervised diffusion pre-training used 'the entire dataset' incl. validation samples (transductive). Behaviour classes are the AI output, but only F1/G-mean reported, no ecological behaviour quantity -> E1=없음. ENV coded from 'sea-weed nests' in shallow NE Atlantic coast (temperate algal habitat; verify). Detector fine-tuned on own corkwing boxes (Knausgård 2022); detection/tracking not evaluated here. Data cleaning removed tracker failures/duplicate-frame trajectories (not coded C5).
AUTHORS_FULL: Canovi, N; Ellis, BA; Sordalen, TK; Allken, V; Halvorsen, KT; Malde, K; Beyan, C
